summary:
ANIMA v7 is an ERC-721 (IDontFuckingBelieveIt, 20,940 B) that mints, per token, a deterministic CREATE2 NFT account (SovereignAccount, 21,506 B, via SovereignAccountFactory 23,423 B) and renders a fully on-chain tokenURI (ConfluenceRenderer) whose animation_url is a ~15 KB self-verifying HTML loader that fetches, SHA-256-verifies and document.write()s a multi-MB app from STOP-prefixed AppChunk contracts (OnchainApp v1 <=64 chunks, OnchainAppDirectory v2 <=512, OnchainModuleDirectory v3 gzip functional modules) using the viewer's own wallet RPC. Around the token sits a sealed 'Genesis stack' discovered through a publish-once GenesisManifest: NativeMarket (constant-product swap, 30 bps, swap-and-lock), GenesisLaunchpad (pro-rata batch sale that seeds permanent liquidity and vests founders through TimeVault), TimeVault (cliff/linear locks, no admin), WorldLedger (public rooms, reactions, profiles, follow/block, consent-epoch moderation, protocol-attributed activity feed), MemoryLedger + JournalSwapRouter (public/encrypted journal with reflection branches and journaled swaps), VestedExitVault, EstateExchange (sells the NFT under a declared-inventory covenant) and a real Uniswap-v4 market (V4GenesisMarket + PhoenixLaunchHook).

Version 7 adds a per-NFT installable program system: ModuleArchiveFactory -> ExtensionReleaseRegistry (publisher-namespaced immutable releases with exact dependencies) -> TokenModuleRegistry (atomic release+state activation, append-only roots/history, stale-review protection) -> ModuleStateStore (<=32 KiB snapshots stored as AppChunks; measured 7,713,661 gas for 32,768 bytes under the EIP-7825 16,777,216 cap), plus ChunkedCartridgeRegistry (ERC721 cartridges whose HTML is byte-exact recoverable and whose launch authorization follows the holding NFT's current owner) and ModuleWorkbench (a second recoverable 707,014-byte page exposing services()). A long tail of optional extensions exists: encrypted group chat (EpochGroupChat, MLSGroupChat, PrivacyKeys), LayerZero OFT lane and read-only state portal, agents (ERC-8183 draft, policy guard, provider directory), gas sponsorship, ENS subnames, streaming uniform-price auction, quadratic matching, fractional custody/governance, experimental DeFi gated to testnets, and a Groth16 quote proof.

The two load-bearing protocol ideas are (1) identity = the NFT's account: every peripheral checks collection.accountOf(id)==msg.sender while the account only obeys ownerOf(id); approvals and ERC-4907 users never gain authority; and (2) a custody epoch (SovereignAccount.sessionEpoch) bumped on every transfer and re-read by every grant, invitation, plan, listing and UI review. Ownership gating is therefore client-side (ConfluenceWallet.connect reads ownerOf at a pinned block and refuses non-owners) plus contract-enforced. Weaknesses: not canonical ERC-6551, two contracts within 1.2 KB of EIP-170, admin keys until freeze/seal, swap v1 has no LP layer, messages stored in contract storage, loader requires an RPC in the viewer (no web3:// route), mixed revert styles and heavily minified Solidity, ganache-based tests. Verdict: adapt the account/custody-epoch model, the chunked app + loader, the module/state registries, TimeVault, WorldLedger, launchpad and v4 market; drop sovereign/proof/agent/crosschain/experimental tails.

website_delivery: From chain, no server, no IPFS. IDontFuckingBelieveIt.tokenURI -> ConfluenceRenderer.render -> data:application/json;base64 with image = base64 GenesisSVG and animation_url = data:text/html;base64 of '<script>window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY={seed,genome,root,chainId,collection,tokenId,manifest,privacyResource,runtime,sha256,archiveVersion}</script>' + the ~15 KB ConfluenceLoader page (kept in an AppChunk deployed by the renderer constructor). Opened in a wallet browser (or with a pasted HTTPS/localhost RPC) the loader pins a block, eth_calls chunkCount()/readChunk(i) on the runtime archive (OnchainApp v1 <=64 chunks of <=23,000 B; OnchainAppDirectory v2 <=512 chunks; OnchainModuleDirectory v3 <=32 gzip functional modules assembled into a data: import map), re-hashes with its own SHA-256, and document.write()s the full app (measured: 7,952,983-byte Genesis app + 707,014-byte workbench recovered exactly in 6,080 ms in the Chromium gate; local HTML archive 409,658 B in 18 chunks). Service discovery: AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY.manifest -> GenesisManifest.modulesOf(collection) -> [market, vault, memory, ledger, cartridges, exit]; the v7 workbench is a second ModuleWorkbench anchor with services(). There is NO web3:// (ERC-5219) or ERC-4804 router in this repo; the hosted index.html (477 KB) is a dev copy only. Cartridges, module releases and state snapshots are recovered the same way (ChunkedCartridgeRegistry.contentOf, ModuleStateStore.dataOf).
wallet_gating: Two layers, no SIWE/server. Client: web/confluence/wallet.mjs ConfluenceWallet.connect(collection, tokenId) asserts the page's baked identity matches, eth_requestAccounts, reads ownerOf/accountOf/renderSnapshot at one pinned block and throws 'This wallet does not own the selected NFT.' if ownerOf != connected address; requires code at the account; accountsChanged/chainChanged invalidate the session. The v7 workbench (web/modules/adapter.mjs, sdk.readRegistry) additionally requires ownerOf == account.currentOwner() == connected address and binds every prepared review to {owner, sessionEpoch} ('NFT ownership or custody epoch changed.'). Chain: every action is a transaction from the owner to SovereignAccount.execute/executeUtility (or executeInstrument by a grantee); onlyController is msg.sender == collection.ownerOf(tokenId) (SovereignAccount.sol:504-506); peripherals require collection.accountOf(identity) == msg.sender (ProtocolGuard._identity) and the module registry also checks currentOwner()==ownerOf and sessionEpoch (TokenModuleRegistry._authorize, StaleReview).
